title: Gallatin Lakeside Townhome Near Many Restaurants
description:
Escape to this lakeside retreat close to Nashville, next to Gallatin Marina and Old Hickory Lake! Our townhome features a bonus room upstairs & 3 spacious bedrooms, perfect for families or groups. Indulge in lakeside activities such as boat rentals or tiki cruises or explore local dining at Awedaddy's Bar & Grill (seasonal) and many other dining options at The Shops at Windsong. For more adventure, downtown Broadway is only 30 miles away. Experience the perfect mix of relaxation and excitement!

The space
This spacious home features 3 large bedrooms, each with a king bed. The master suite is conveniently located downstairs with an en-suite bathroom. Upstairs, you’ll find two more bedrooms and a full bathroom, plus a second living area with two couches and a pull-out couch, perfect for additional guests. Enjoy the inviting back patio, ideal for relaxing and just a 2 minute walk to Awedaddy's Restaurant.

Other things to note
Our home is conveniently located next to Awedaddy's Bar & Grill, featuring an outdoor patio, indoor seating, and live music on weekends. Just 3 miles away, explore The Shops at Windsong, home to Publix Grocery Store, Agaves Mexican Restaurant, Jonathan’s Bar & Grill, Tropical Smoothie, Wing Stop, a gas station, a nail salon, Moo Yah, Sense of Taste, and Dutch Bros. With so many nearby attractions, you'll have everything you need for a fantastic stay! For more adventure, downtown Broadway in Nashville is only 30 miles away.
